response.original_title: Psychodrama czyli bajka o księciu i kopciuszku wystawiona w zakładzie dla nieletnich dziewcząt w D.
response.overview: At a juvenile correctional facility, teenage girls rehearse and perform *Cinderella* under the supervision of their educators. The story of a mistreated orphan dreaming of a fairytale prince becomes a reflection of their own hardships and hopes.
